@@ -55,3 +55,12 @@ def test_existing_orders_load_on_open(page: Page, client):
     client.post("/orders", json={"item": "cup", "qty": 1, "price_cents": 100})
     page.goto("/")
     expect(page.locator("#orders li")).to_have_count(2)
+
+
+def test_add_several_orders(page: Page):
+    page.goto("/")
+    for item in {"pen", "cup", "hat"}:
+        add(page, item)
+        expect(page.get_by_placeholder("Item")).to_have_value("")
+    expect(page.locator("#orders li")).to_have_count(3)
+    expect(page.locator("#orders li").first).to_contain_text("hat")
